name: msc104
title: Microsoft C 1.04 (Lattice C; MC1.EXE and MC2.EXE), 1983
_stage: every file of the release's disks, beside the passes (they find the headers there)
_variants: own: the code generator MC1.EXE and MC2.EXE 1.04 were compiled by (between the two shipped); older: the one the library modules linked into them were compiled by

patches.note: it does not yet drop the register contents when it widens a byte (xor ah,ah): a jump over the two calls that do
the switch emitter's compare of each case of a compare chain: cmp al,imm8 (3Ch), not cmp ax,imm16

cmp_test.note: comparing two longs, both words of the left one first only if neither is reached through a pointer
